verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents real-time HTTP webhook notifications for card transaction events (approved, declined, settled, failed) with signature verification via HMAC-SHA256, and further mentions real-time webhooks in its Instant Pay product. This directly satisfies the story of subscribing to events via webhooks. Missing for 10: no documentation of a full webhook subscription/management API (e.g., listing available event types, registering endpoints programmatically) or independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
